# @zakkster/lite-yggdrasil

> A zero-GC engine for mutable ordered sequences where the position of anything is a running total (planned).

Version: 0.0.0
Status: pre-release. Nothing is built yet; the engine is planned, not shipped.

Current export: VERSION (string).

PLANNED exports (not implemented, do not call them):
- SumSequence (first engine, planned v0.1.0)
- SumMap
- IntervalMap
- Yggdrasil

Planned idea: the summary with dimensions -- seek by any running total.
Main file: Yggdrasil.js (ESM). Types: Yggdrasil.d.ts. Error tag (planned): [lite-yggdrasil].
Plan: ROADMAP.md, RESEARCH.md, SCOPE.md (repo only, not in the npm package).
